title: Banks Act Directive D2/2015 — Effective risk data aggregation and risk reporting
enablingLegislation: Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This directive is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Effective risk data aggregation and risk reporting.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This directive applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Effective risk data aggregation and risk reporting.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Effective risk data aggregation and risk reporting. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This directive remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
